name: Flutter SDK
description: Installs the Flutter SDK (with its bundled Dart) from the official stable release archive into /opt/flutter, owned by the remote user so the first-run engine.stamp write succeeds. Optionally installs an OpenJDK for Android/Gradle builds and runs `flutter precache`.

version.description: Flutter release to install, e.g. '3.41.4'. 'latest' resolves the newest release on the chosen channel.

channel.description: Release channel to pull the archive from.

installJdk.description: Also install a headless OpenJDK for Android/Gradle builds.

jdkVersion.description: OpenJDK major version to install when installJdk is true.

precache.description: Run `flutter precache` after install to warm the artifact cache.
